name: amber
description: Contract-checking harness: delegation inside an approved contract, explicit boundaries, model-owned semantic completion review, and a shared ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Use clear contracts and review completion evidence.
interface.longDescription: Amber defines a work contract, checks supported tool calls against its boundaries, prompts the current model to review every required condition before completion, records cycle events and reviewed completion signals, and releases a contract on a passed completion. Shared skills support Claude Code and Codex.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $amber:status to show Amber's installation and active contract.
